title: New board defaults
help: What every new workspace board is born with. An open board keeps its own copy.

groups.label: New boards
groups.help: Inherited once when a folder is first opened as a workspace.

groups.label: Agent
groups.help: The pi child process that answers the first thread on a new board.

groups.label: Model & reasoning
groups.help: Validated against POST /defaults; the daemon refuses a model this machine cannot run.

fields.label: model
fields.help: Provider and model id separated by /. Scoped models from ~/.pi/agent/settings.json appear first.

fields.label: thinking
fields.help: Reasoning budget passed to pi for new threads. Clamped if a model does not support it.

groups.label: Cards
groups.help: What a new board's threads put on a card, how often, and for whom. A level is a default: asking for the thing by name overrides it for that card. The words behind each id are under Prompts below.

fields.label: card verbosity
fields.help: quiet: a card only when asked. normal: a card for something that has to be seen. verbose: a card for every finding.

fields.label: cards written for
fields.help: The register of a card: what is explained, and in which words. The words live in prompts/audiences/.

fields.label: code fragments
fields.help: none: words only. some: an identifier, a path, a short snippet. many: a block whenever the code is the answer. "Show me the function" overrides it.

fields.label: math formulas
fields.help: none: plain words and numbers. some: notation inline. many: the derivation, not only the result.

fields.label: charts
fields.help: none: no chart, no table of numbers. some: one where it carries the point. many: a chart per series, a table per comparison.

fields.label: references
fields.help: none: no source block. some: a source for every claim that is not the agent's own reasoning. many: a source for every factual statement. "Where does that come from" overrides it.

fields.label: dim others
fields.help: Dim other cards on the canvas while one thread is selected.

groups.label: Workflow
groups.help: How the work a child does comes back onto the board's own branch.

fields.label: a child's work comes back by
fields.help: merge: the child's branch is merged in, and the merge stays visible in the history. cherry-pick: its commits are lifted across. rebase: its commits are replayed.
